Enhance CMDB Fidelity
Improve CMDB data quality with continuous asset reconciliation
Axonius turns your CMDB from a static inventory into a trusted source of truth — continuously reconciled with what’s in your environment.
Get a Personalized Demo
Product Tour
See how Axonius improves CMDB data quality by surfacing what's missing, correcting what's wrong, and keeping records accurate as your environment changes.
CMDB data quality shouldn't depend on manual cleanup
Your CMDB’s data quality degrades fast. Brittle discovery architectures can't keep up with rapidly changing environments, and manual reconciliation cycles guarantee your records are already stale by the time they're updated.
Axonius helps teams continuously
reconcile and enrich CMDB records
with real-time asset data and metadata, so decisions, remediation, and automations are based on what actually exists — not assumptions. Security and IT get accurate ownership, context, and insights they can confidently act on.
Get a Personalized Demo
Why teams choose Axonius for CMDB accuracy
Continuous CMDB accuracy without manual cleanups:
Axonius eliminates the "manual reconciliation loop" by continuously validating and enriching asset records in real-time. This ensures that ownership, lifecycle state, and configuration data stay current as the environment changes, not just when a periodic scan runs.
Unified model for Security and IT:
Axonius aligns Security and IT onto a single operational baseline. By resolving the discrepancies between what security tools see and what the CMDB reports, teams stop debating data quality and start using the CMDB as a trusted backbone for audits, resilience, and modernization.
Get a Personalized Demo
The metrics that prove your CMDB data is actually accurate
Mean Time to Reconciliation (MTTR)
Total time saved by replacing manual cross-referencing and data cleanup with automated, continuous updates to CMDB records.
Unmanaged Asset Discovery Rate
Percentage reduction in shadow IT or unmanaged assets found through CMDB discovery in Axonius that were previously missing from the CMDB system of record.
Data Enrichment Fidelity
The average number of additional, high-context data fields (e.g., owner, business criticality, location) successfully populated in the CMDB per asset record.

See the Story
See how CMDB reconciliation works in Axonius
Step 1:
Build a trusted, correlated view of your asset landscape
Getting true visibility into what actually exists in your environment, and all of the associated metadata, is the first step to strengthening your overall cyber resilience. Show connectors, data sources, and example data pulled from a source.
Step 2:
Determine assets in scope
The Axonius Asset Cloud lets you easily visualize only the assets that need to be kept accurate in the CMDB, and build dashboards to track those assets over time.
Step 3:
Visualize CMDB asset gaps
With an active connection to your CMDB, it’s straightforward to see which scoped assets already exist in the CMDB and which don’t.
Step 4:
Visualize CMDB asset inaccuracies
Assets may exist in the CMDB and still have issues keeping associated metadata, like asset owner, lifecycle state, or IP address accurate over time.
Step 5:
Automate remediation
Using the Action Center in Axonius, leverage an existing Enforcement Set to open a ticket to update the CMDB, or build a custom workflow to directly create or update a CI in the CMDB.
